player_prompt.intro:
Yin a luui Mastermind.
Yin a ci loŋo kɔɔdi {code_length} ciɛl kɛɛl, ciɛl kɛɛl wɛɛr 1 tɛɛ {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Yin a wɛɛrɛŋ, yin a ci luui kɔɔdi kɛɛl kɛɛl wɛɛr '[2 1 4 5]'.
Ciɛl kɔɔdi kɛɛl kɛɛl, yin a ci nɛɛŋ pɛɛgi kɛɛl wɛɛr kɔɔr ɛɛŋ kɛɛl wɛɛr.
Pɛɛgi kɔɔr ɛɛŋ a ci nɛɛŋ ciɛl kɔɔdi kɛɛl wɛɛr, wɛɛlɛ pɛɛgi kɔɔr ɛɛŋ a ci nɛɛŋ ciɛl kɔɔdi kɛɛl wɛɛr wɛɛr.
Yin a {max_turns} kɔɔdi kɛɛl ciɛl kɔɔdi.
player_prompt.with_repeats: kɛ mi̱ de rɔ nyɔk ni̱ la̱t.

invalid_move.wrong_format: /Ka̱n ji̱ jäk kɛ ɣöö bi thöpni jɛ ɛ la mi̱ ci̱ kuɛn kä ca mat rɛy wargakä.
invalid_move.not_integers: Kɛn nyin gɔ̱rä diaal ba kɛ dhil la intejeri̱ ti̱ gɔw.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Kä guäcdɛ bɛ cu tekɛ nämbäri̱ {code_length} ɛ päär.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kuen diaal ba kɛ dhil te kam 1 kɛnɛ {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Kuen tin la̱tkɛ kɛ dup /ca bi met nhɔk.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Ci̱ kɛ ku thuŋ ŋa̱c {guess}. Kuɛ la ɣöö bi̱ ca̱r dɔ̱diɛn nyɔk kɛ ɣɔ̱n.

game_action.feedback: Yin a ci luui [{guess}]. Pɛɛgi: {black_pegs} pɛɛgi kɔɔr, {white_pegs} pɛɛgi kɔɔr wɛɛr.

outcome.win: Yin aci luɔi kuɔr, cɔl {black_pegs} kɛn ë tiɛm ë {code_length} tiɛm ë cɔl.
outcome.turn_limit: Ci̱ pek in deri̱ rɔ ri̱t cop. Ji̱n ci̱ jɛ ŋa̱c i̱ ɛ {percent} perthäntig nämbäri̱ tin ca tɔ̱w kɛ duɔ̱ɔ̱p mi̱ cuŋ.
